# Rewrite m2 tests - replace the passing numeric increment test
m2_test = '''"""Tests for milestone m2: Fix bump_build to handle non-numeric build segments."""


def test_bump_build_non_numeric_appends_zero():
    """bump_build should append .0 when the last build segment is not numeric."""
    from semver.version import Version
    v = Version.parse("1.2.3+alpha")
    bumped = v.bump_build()
    assert bumped.build == "alpha.0"


def test_bump_build_returns_new_version():
    """bump_build should return a new Version instance without modifying the original."""
    from semver.version import Version
    v = Version.parse("1.2.3+alpha")
    original_build = v.build
    bumped = v.bump_build()
    assert v.build == original_build
    assert bumped.build != original_build


def test_bump_build_multi_segment_non_numeric():
    """bump_build should append .0 to multi-segment non-numeric build metadata."""
    from semver.version import Version
    v = Version.parse("1.2.3+alpha.beta")
    bumped = v.bump_build()
    assert bumped.build == "alpha.beta.0"


def test_bump_build_with_prerelease_and_build():
    """bump_build should append .0 to non-numeric build while preserving prerelease."""
    from semver.version import Version
    v = Version.parse("1.2.3-rc.1+alpha")
    bumped = v.bump_build()
    assert bumped.prerelease == "rc.1"
    assert bumped.build == "alpha.0"
'''

with open('crucible_hidden/test_m2.py', 'w') as f:
    f.write(m2_test)

print("Written test_m2.py")
